import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"

# Create submission directory if it does not exist
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv")

# Define features
X_train = train_df.drop(["id", "target"], axis=1)
y_train = train_df["target"]
X_test = test_df.drop(["id"], axis=1)
train_ids = train_df["id"]
test_ids = test_df["id"]

# Identify ALL categorical features including low-cardinality integer features
# f_27 is high-cardinality object, f_29 and f_30 are low-cardinality integers
cat_features = ["f_27", "f_29", "f_30"]

# Convert categorical columns to integer encoding for LightGBM
# LightGBM requires categorical features to be integers (0, 1, 2, ...)
for cat_col in cat_features:
    cat_values = list(X_train[cat_col].unique())
    cat_to_int = {val: i for i, val in enumerate(cat_values)}
    X_train[cat_col] = X_train[cat_col].map(cat_to_int)

# Apply same mapping to test data
for cat_col in cat_features:
    X_test[cat_col] = X_test[cat_col].map(cat_to_int)

# Ensure target is binary 0/1
y_train = y_train.astype(int)

# Verify dtypes
print(
    f"Categorical columns dtypes: {[f'{c}: {X_train[c].dtype}' for c in cat_features]}"
)
print(f"Training target unique values: {y_train.unique()}")

# Stratified train/validation split
# This ensures the validation set is a genuine hold-out test set
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_train, random_state=42
)

# Prepare LightGBM data with ALL categorical features specified
train_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_train_split,
    label=y_train_split,
    feature_name=X_train_split.columns.tolist(),
    categorical_feature=cat_features,
)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val_split,
    label=y_val_split,
    feature_name=X_val_split.columns.tolist(),
    reference=train_data,
)

# Model parameters for LightGBM
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Train model
print("Training LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=2000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val_split)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_split, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Predicting on test set...")
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission dataframe - use float to match sample submission format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids.values, "target": test_predictions})

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Total test predictions: {len(test_predictions)}")
print(f"Test set shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Categorical features used: {cat_features}")
